mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% and rises by more than 0.1 percentage points in a month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate over the past month indicates improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market that accelerates economic recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5% and UNRATE declines by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 650,000 units per month, it signals a strengthening housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 650.0 units.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) both increase by at least 0.5% from the previous month, it signals synchronized strength in consumer demand and business activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and INDPRO rise by at least 0.5% from the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In industrial recovery regimes (INDPRO > 100), a rise in industrial production signals expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100 and INDPRO rises by at least 0.2 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A positive growth rate in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strengthening consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS grows by at least 0.3% from the prior month.
